claim: The reviewer mistook the borderless disabled button for plain text.

sourceEvidence.finding: The actual JSX always renders a button, keeps it in place after resend, sets aria-disabled when done, and changes its visible name to Remis en file.

runtimeEvidence.finding: The completed real capture waited for getByRole(button, /^Remis en file/) and asserted aria-disabled=true before verifying only the failed email was resent and a repeated resend created nothing.

visualEvidence.finding: Remis en file is visible at the original button location; its borderless styling matches current main. The independently reviewed synchronization checkpoints all have severity none.
